oversizedFiles.src/pipeline_session.cpp: What remains is one class definition: PipelineSession::Impl, whose ~60 members are defined inline and share the session's tensor caches, scheduler histories, and cursors that the file-local SessionState base bundles, plus StageRun::Impl, which owns a run's identity, slot, admission lease, telemetry, and cancellation linkage against those same members. The stage strategy bodies that used to live here -- autoregressive decoding, iterative scheduler stepping, and the shared one pass -- were extracted into src/stage_executor.cpp, src/stage_executor_autoregressive.cpp, and src/stage_executor_iterative.cpp behind detail::StageExecutionHost, which is why this file no longer contains any per-kind step logic. The rest is coupled to PipelineSession::Impl itself: it is private to PipelineSession, every member function here reaches its members directly, and splitting further would require publishing that type in an internal header and redistributing interlocking members across translation units, which is a mechanical split with no natural, testable responsibility boundary. Independent concerns were already factored out into src/pipeline_manifest_common.cpp, src/pipeline_manifest_validation.cpp, src/pipeline_scheduler.cpp, src/pipeline_telemetry.cpp, and src/stage_registry.cpp.
